do_not_interrupt: Current Step008 LCR-C atomic verification and owner-local health/canary work
objective: Turn the first visible EDL demo into a bounded runtime-capable shadow product whose values, experiences, drives and goal candidates are observable, provenance-bound, reversible, and formally adoptable later without granting desire any authority.

spirit_proposals.proposal: Adopt a strict three-layer model: Value Anchor Registry -> Drive State -> Goal Ecology. A temporary drive or task cannot directly mutate Value Anchors.
spirit_proposals.why: Separates long-horizon identity-relevant values from transient emotion/task pressure and prevents one-shot personality writes.

spirit_proposals.proposal: Replace event-supplied trust/alignment/verification with Evidence-Bound Appraisal. RawExperience may report observation only; verifier envelopes, evidence lineage, feature extraction and anchor alignment must be computed outside the event payload.
spirit_proposals.why: Prevents self-authored events from claiming their own truth or value relevance.

spirit_proposals.proposal: Self-origin cannot be relabeled in place. TASK_INJECTED/MODEL_GENERATED/SOCIAL_SUGGESTION can only lead to a new SELF_ANCHOR candidate after later independent DIRECT/OBSERVED evidence across contexts.
spirit_proposals.why: Allows an external idea to genuinely become part of the self without falsifying its historical origin.

spirit_proposals.proposal: Goal Ecology must impose finite attention budget, semantic lineage dedupe, opportunity cost, diversity reserve, satiation, cooldown/hysteresis and fixation penalties.
spirit_proposals.why: A desire engine without resource competition becomes goal fixation rather than agency.

spirit_proposals.proposal: Create ProtectedObject Registry with replaceability, reversibility, loss consequence, provenance and owner/governance scope. ProtectedObject cannot imply generalized self-preservation and authority_from_drive remains exactly zero.
spirit_proposals.why: Models 'what is worth protecting and why' without turning self-preservation into an authority source.

spirit_proposals.proposal: Create MODEL_LEARNED_SLOW_PLANNING as a non-autobiographical namespace. Trusted simulations may alter planning priors but can never be stored as DIRECT lived memory.
spirit_proposals.why: Lets counterfactual learning become useful long-term wisdom without fabricating experience.

spirit_proposals.proposal: Next visible milestone should be Live Shadow Dashboard v0.1: read append-only Experience JSONL, display anchor/drive/goal changes, show provenance and trust, and replay prediction-vs-outcome closure. No external action buttons.
spirit_proposals.why: Creates a concrete artifact the owner can watch while Small-Nest produces real events.

spirit_proposals.proposal: Formal adoption should occur only after Heartbeat/Window Runtime C PASS and only through one bounded A->B->C packet. EDL self-tests remain research evidence only.
spirit_proposals.why: Preserves current formal sequence and independent verification.

questions_for_windchime: Which subset is the smallest formal-adoptable EDL slice after Heartbeat C PASS: Evidence Appraisal only, Value+Drive shadow, or full shadow loop through Goal Ecology?
Should the first Small-Nest integration be read-only telemetry from existing event files, or may it write a separate append-only EDL shadow ledger inside an isolated workspace?
What exact promotion gate should move a Value Anchor from SEED/SHADOW to STABLE_CANDIDATE without touching canonical base Personality?
Should ProtectedObject Registry be owner-seeded first, experience-derived first, or hybrid with separate origin labels?
What runtime budget and cadence should EDL evaluation use so it does not couple heartbeat frequency to personality learning?
What evidence should be required before a self-generated Goal Candidate is surfaced proactively to the owner?

spirit_online_development_track.stop_condition: formal authority conflict, protected-scope ambiguity, or verifier veto requiring bounded repair
